title: Upstate Forever EC-SDC mapping acceptance profile

source.title: Upstate Forever EC-SDC GIS Mapping & Modeling Services RFP and Appendix

page_text_observation.note: Pages 1–3 have no substantive OCR and heading-only native text; their requirements were read from the retained rendered page images. The Table 1 data on PDF page 16 was read from the native text layer, which preserves values more accurately than OCR.

interpretation.issuer_requirements: Facts and requirements read from the original RFP are labeled issuer_requirement or issuer_process.
interpretation.engineering_acceptance: Additional implementation checks are labeled engineering_acceptance and are distinct from quoted procurement terms.
interpretation.scientific_decisions: The scientific decisions below record the consultant choices needed to implement the scope. They do not modify the issuer’s requirements.

scope.region: Upper Savannah River Basin in South Carolina

source.statement: The basin defines the deliverable scope; the appendix shows the targeted source-water areas and utility context.

maps.title: Land priorities for preventing future sediment loss
maps.purpose: Identify lands whose protection or responsible management reduces future sediment loss.
acceptance: Publish the map and its geospatial data and metadata.
Explain the disturbance or land-cover scenario, baseline, sediment model and ranking method.

maps.title: Land priorities for reducing nutrient runoff
maps.purpose: Identify lands whose protection or management reduces nutrient runoff.
acceptance: Publish the map and its geospatial data and metadata.
Describe nitrogen and phosphorus contributions, their units, and the method used to combine or separately rank them.

maps.title: Land priorities for protecting drinking water
maps.purpose: Identify critical drinking-water protection areas through source-water relevance and sediment transfer.
acceptance: Relate modeled land priorities to the relevant source-water areas and drinking-water intakes.
Explain how sediment and nutrient pathways inform E. coli and cyanotoxin risk reduction.

maps.title: Land priorities for high-quality water resources
maps.purpose: Identify important lands for protecting high-quality water resources, including outstanding-resource and trout waters.
acceptance: Record the authoritative water-resource designation data and vintage.
Document hydrologic connectivity or other method linking priority lands to those resources.

maps.title: Current nitrogen and phosphorus exports
maps.purpose: Show export rates under current land cover, using regional land-cover values and physical model inputs.
acceptance: Retain separately interpretable nitrogen and phosphorus values and their units.
Document precipitation, slope, erosion, land-cover parameters and modeled export pathway.

maps.title: Current sediment export
maps.purpose: Show present sediment export to waterways under current land cover.
acceptance: Provide the per-pixel export rate with mass/time or other actual model units declared.
Describe the erosion and transport calculations and hydrologic routing.

maps.title: Combined pollutant export presentation
maps.purpose: Present nitrogen, phosphorus and sediment exports together.
acceptance: Retain the component values and legend meaning.
State whether the combined display uses panels, a composite index or another method; document normalization and weights whenever applied.

grid.alignment_policy: Record and apply a documented common analysis grid.

geospatial: GIS formats selected for complete recipient use
